M0 invisibility proof — compositor and seam
docs/plans/active/workspace-windowing-system.md, M0 ship criterion

M0 changes how the workspace preview is composed, not what it draws: the box
type, the frame's ownership of a leaf's header row, the canvas blit that
replaced the two-leaf joins, the content contract, one zoom rule, hit regions
registered from the placements the canvas drew from, and one floors authority.
The claim the milestone makes is that none of it reaches a cell. This directory
is that claim measured against a real Sidecar process rather than asserted.

Method
------
Two binaries, one built at db8c342 (the tree M0 started from) and one at the
head of M0, driven through the same key sequence at two sizes, on private tmux
servers and private state trees. The captures below are the M0 binary's
ANSI-stripped pane text with trailing spaces removed; the comparison itself was
made on the raw captures, escape sequences included, so a styling change would
have shown even where the glyphs agreed.

Every state matched byte for byte at both sizes. The only masked difference is
the header and footer clock, which advances between two runs by construction.
No transcript in this repository was re-recorded, because nothing M0 did made
one stale.

Isolation (`./scripts/tmux-drive.sh paths` before each run)
  outer server  -L sidecar-drive
  base run dir  /private/tmp/sidecar-m0-base-501
  head run dir  /private/tmp/sidecar-m0-head-501
  inner tmux    <run dir>/tmux/tmux-501/default
  state home    <run dir>/state
  config        <run dir>/config/config.json
  SIDECAR_ISOLATED_STATE=1
The machine's default tmux server was never started, stopped, or sent a command.

Reproduce
---------
  mkdir -p /tmp/sidecar-m0-base-src
  git archive db8c342 | tar -x -C /tmp/sidecar-m0-base-src
  (cd /tmp/sidecar-m0-base-src && go build -o sidecar-base ./cmd/sidecar)
  go build -o /tmp/sidecar-m0-head/sidecar ./cmd/sidecar

  # once per binary, with SIDECAR_DRIVE_RUN_DIR and SIDECAR_BIN set to it:
  ./scripts/tmux-drive.sh start 200 50     -> wide-01-startup
  ./scripts/tmux-drive.sh keys 4           -> wide-02-workspaces
  ./scripts/tmux-drive.sh keys j           -> wide-03-after-j
  ./scripts/tmux-drive.sh keys j           -> wide-04-after-jj
  ./scripts/tmux-drive.sh keys 2           -> wide-05-git
  ./scripts/tmux-drive.sh stop
  # then the same sequence at 100x30 for the narrow-* captures

  diff <(sed 's/[0-9][0-9]:[0-9][0-9]/CLOCK/g' base/<state>.txt) \
       <(sed 's/[0-9][0-9]:[0-9][0-9]/CLOCK/g' head/<state>.txt)

What each state exercises
-------------------------
  01-startup      App chrome and the td plugin: the frame M0 did not touch,
                  present so a difference anywhere would be attributable.
  02-workspaces   The workspace sidebar beside the preview box. The preview is
                  the terminal leaf of a one-leaf pane tree, so this is the
                  path where terminalLeafBox now reads Zoomed and the floors
                  from one authority instead of its own literal.
  03-after-j      Selection moves to a shell; the preview follows it. The
                  terminal surface is composed from the leaf box.
  04-after-jj     Selection on a workspace with no agent: the same leaf box
                  with a different content.
  05-git          Leaving the plugin, to catch a change that only shows once
                  the workspace view has been built and torn down.

Not covered here
----------------
A document pane open beside the terminal is the composition M0 rewrote, and it
cannot be reached headlessly: a doc leaf is born from a markdown path in live
agent output. That path is covered instead by the cell-exact goldens over a
three-leaf and a nested four-leaf tree in
internal/plugins/workspace/pane_compositor_test.go, which assert every composed
cell, each divider's own box, and every leaf and divider hit region.
